text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, while out with Jungle Pocket—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking in the direction Jungle Pocket pointed,
there was a crane game filled with plushies
themed after Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
So this plushie was here all along!
Heheh♪ Guess I gotta win it!
choice_data_list: Do you want a Paka Petit?
Do you want a Paka Petit?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, well. The magic trick Fuji-san did with this
was seriously so cool!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
You put an Umamusume's photo into the box, see.
And then, when you snap your fingers—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume in the photo has been turned into a plushie!
Isn't that insane?!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"I was thinking of trying that magic trick too.
I'm gonna pull it off looking cool, just like Fuji-san!"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, I messed up.
My wallet's totally empty."
choice_data_list: Then I'll get it for you instead.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Looks like I owe you one.
I'm counting on you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
